data.title: 雷电将军 · 离岛海滨的清凉微风
data.description: 离岛的午后海风掠过白沙，雷电影穿着深紫色泳装站在浅浅的浪线旁。她双手扶着遮阳伞柄，回过头确认你是否跟上，长长的紫色发辫被风带向一侧。伞影刚好遮住她的脸，露出带着一点拘谨的浅笑，身后的蓝海与云层在日光里显得格外明亮。
data.location: 离岛蔚蓝海岸的白沙滩
data.action: 赤足站在白沙浅浪旁，双手扶遮阳伞柄，回眸露出拘谨的浅笑。
data.camera: full body, eye level, seaside portrait
data.promptProse: Afternoon wind carries Raiden Ei's long purple braid sideways along the white beach at Ritou. She stands barefoot beside the shallow foam in her purple swimsuit, both hands steadying a parasol handle. Turning back to check that the viewer has followed, she offers a small, slightly awkward smile beneath the parasol shade. Clear blue water and sunlit clouds fill the distance. The full-length eye-level portrait keeps her feet, parasol and coastline together.
